# create-nuvsha

Scaffold a new Nuvsha project in seconds.

## Usage

```bash
npx create-nuvsha my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

## What it generates

```text
my-app/
├── package.json       # project dependencies
├── vite.config.js     # Vite + Nuvsha plugin setup
├── index.html         # HTML shell
└── src/
    ├── main.js        # application entry point
    └── App.nuv        # your first Nuvsha component
```
